Description:
关于本模组
所有外观均采用 四倍高清 像素绘制，并通过 Fashion Sense 框架加载。

本模组包含：

· 💇 1 款发型 — 飘逸的棕色低马尾
· 👗 1 条裙子 — 红白拼色连衣裙，配有标志性黑色蝴蝶结装饰


使用说明

1. 确保已安装 SMAPI 和 Fashion Sense
2. 下载后将压缩包解压至 Stardew Valley/Mods 文件夹
3. 进入游戏，通过 Fashion Sense 的换装界面穿戴即可

前置需求

· SMAPI
· Fashion Sense (FS)

本模组为纯外观美化，不修改任何游戏机制，可随时安装或卸载。

English Description

Candy Heart Rose — 4x HD Outfit Set

About This Mod

Candy Heart Rose is a sweet‑and‑edgy outfit set for Stardew Valley, featuring a classic red‑and‑white color palette with bold black ribbon bows. All assets are hand‑drawn in 4x HD pixel art and powered by the Fashion Sense framework, bringing a polished and stylish look to your farmer!

This Mod Includes:

· 💇 1 Hairstyle — a chic, edgy cut that complements the overall vibe
· 👗 1 Dress — a red‑and‑white paneled dress with a signature black bow detail

The design blends sweet girlish charm with cool, rebellious accents — perfect for daily farm life or festival dances alike.

How to Use

1. Make sure you have SMAPI and Fashion Sense installed
2. Download and extract the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
3. In‑game, use the Fashion Sense dressing menu to equip the items

Requirements

· SMAPI
· Fashion Sense (FS)

This is a purely cosmetic mod. It does not alter any gameplay mechanics and can be safely added or removed at any time.
